Opponents are covered in odd poison goo. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
Pure salt that can be discovered deep inside the Shoal Cave. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Raises the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.
Reflective scales that act like a mirror. Pokémon are able to recall a past move when gazing into them.
Reins that people presented to the king. They allow Calyrex to communicate with its beloved steed.
The Alola region's specialty--fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests in Sinnoh.
The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.
The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This move can also be used to move boulders.
The user attacks and steals the target's item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.
The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.
The user attacks the target's throat, which prevents it from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
The user attacks with an exploding pollen puff. If the target is an ally, it restores its HP instead.
The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.
The user avenges a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move's power is increased.
The user charges the target at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.
The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.
The user dives on the first turn, and floats up and attacks on the second. It can be used to dive in the ocean.
The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
The user drenches the target in a special poison goo. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
The user hurls an electric orb. The faster the user is than the foe, the greater the move's power.
The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opponent's feet. They poison opponents that switch into battle.
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opposing team's feet. They poison opposing Pokemon that switch into battle.
The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
The user regains up to half of its max HP.
The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. This also damages the user a little.
The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may lower the target's Defense.
The user slams with its flaming body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
The user slams with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense.
The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.
The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon's Speed stat is reduced.
The user swings both arms and hits the foe. The foe's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.
The user turns the foe's power against it. The higher the foe's Attack stat, the greater the damage.
The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
This ring contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve.
Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly, but it also lowers its base Attack stat.
